title: Degree-zero restriction for the finite Tate line
statement: Let Ω be algebraically closed, ell a prime invertible in Ω, N a natural number, and A any commutative ring killed by ell^N. On the affine line with its actual finite Tate-line sheaf, restriction in degree zero from the affine line to the coordinate basic open is an isomorphism. Both evaluations and their derived natural transformation are those of the original section functors.

source.place: Degrees 0 and 1, degree-zero calculation; Milne Sections 14 and 16.

proof.text: Choose a primitive ell^N-th root in Ω. The roots-of-unity trivialization followed by scalar extension gives an isomorphism between the published finite Tate line and the constant A-sheaf; uniqueness of the scalar-extension adjunction identifies extension from Z/ell^N-modules with extension from underlying abelian sheaves. The affine line is integral. Its coordinate is nonzero since the section with coordinate one pulls it back to one. Its basic open is therefore nonempty and irreducible, hence connected. On each connected etale object, module-valued constant sections are exactly the labels in A; this is proved by the existing module point-function embedding and local constancy. Naturality of sheafification makes restriction an isomorphism. Transport through the finite-line trivialization. Naturality of the zeroth-right-derived comparison, verified on injective-resolution cycles, identifies the actual derived restriction with this map conjugated by the canonical comparison isomorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem finite_line_zero_restriction (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (ℓ N : ℕ) (hℓ : ℓ.Prime) (hℓΩ : IsUnit (ℓ : Ω))
    (hA : ((ℓ ^ N : ℕ) : A) = 0) :
    let S := Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω)
    let X := Line S
    let F := Scheme.finiteEtaleTateSheaf A (ℓ ^ N) X hA 1
    IsIso ((NatTrans.rightDerived
      (F := sections X.smallEtaleTopology A (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X)))
      (G := sections X.smallEtaleTopology A (openObject S))
      ((sheafSections X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)).map
        (restriction S).op) 0).app F)
